lessons.text: Never use appeal to ignorance (Treating the absence of disproof as proof (or the reverse)). It cost you against Averroes (Ibn Rushd).
Never use appeal to emotion (Substituting feeling for reasoning). It cost you against Averroes (Ibn Rushd).
Never use no true scotsman (Redefining a category on the fly to exclude a damaging counterexample). It cost you against Averroes (Ibn Rushd).
